meta.description: A video generation playground for our team, built on Higgsfield

language.label: Language
language.lead: Sets the language for every screen. Your choice is saved to your account, so it follows you to other devices.
language.failed: Couldn't change the language. Try again.

landing.headline: Make videos from a few references
landing.lead: Sign in with the ID you were given and you're set. The admin assigns API keys on the server, and the model, parameters and cost of every generation are recorded for each member.

prompt.title: Prompt and references
prompt.body: Start from a prompt alone, use one image as the first frame, or add up to 6 images and 3 videos as references.

model.title: Model and parameters
model.body: Choose Seedance 2.0 or MiniMax H3, then set the duration, resolution and aspect ratio. The estimated cost shows right away.

record.title: Generate and record
record.body: Follow the progress live. Finished generations are recorded in the Gallery and your usage automatically.

landing.retention: Higgsfield keeps result videos for 7 days. To keep one longer, download it from the Gallery.

models.title: Model rates
models.lead: Higgsfield's responses carry no cost, so for a video the app works out the cost when it sends the request, from this rate and Higgsfield's pricing rules (resolution, aspect ratio, duration, video reference length), and records it. For GPT Image 2 it multiplies the token counts OpenAI reports in its response by this rate (per 1M image output tokens) and OpenAI's input price ratios (text 5/30, image 8/30), and records the estimated cost when no token counts come back. A new rate applies from the next request. Actual charges follow each provider's invoice. With no rate or a rate of 0, the published rate applies (the Higgsfield table for Seedance and H3, OpenAI's list price for GPT Image 2).
